raw:
Agent Name: WebServing_Expert  
Step Number: 2  
Reason for Mistake: The WebServing_Expert incorrectly identified the landmark on the August 2021 issue of Vogue as the White House, when in reality, it features the Washington Monument in the background. This misidentification led to subsequent steps using the height of the White House (70 feet) instead of the correct height of the Washington Monument (555 feet). This error propagated through the calculations, ultimately resulting in the incorrect answer of 23 yards instead of the correct answer of 185 yards.
